# NODE by Nouvos (N.O.D.E.)

> N.O.D.E. (Network Organized Delivery Engine) is the digital development studio of
> Nouvos Solutions LLC. It delivers web development, design, and marketing under flat
> monthly subscriptions, search optimization (SEO, GEO, AEO) as an add-on, and mobile
> app and custom software development quoted per project, staffed by a dedicated team of designers, developers, and marketers
> rather than a marketplace of freelancers.

## Services
- [Web Development](https://www.nodedev.one/services/web-development): Custom websites and web applications built on Next.js and TypeScript.
- [App Development](https://www.nodedev.one/services/app-development): iOS and Android apps from one shared codebase, through store submission.
- [Software Development](https://www.nodedev.one/services/software-development): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, internal tools, and system integrations.
- [SEO](https://www.nodedev.one/services/seo): Technical, local, and on-page search engine optimization for Google and Bing.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.nodedev.one/services/generative-engine-optimization): Getting a business named and cited in answers from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Copilot.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.nodedev.one/services/answer-engine-optimization): Structuring content so search engines, AI assistants, and voice assistants can quote it as a direct answer.

## Industries
- [Logistics, 3PL, and freight](https://www.nodedev.one/industries/logistics): Websites, quote forms, portals, and integrations for small logistics and supply chain firms.

## Work
- [All case studies](https://www.nodedev.one/work)
- [WECL](https://www.nodedev.one/work/wecl): Editorial website for a supply chain and logistics consulting firm.
- [COnovate](https://www.nodedev.one/work/conovate): WordPress to Astro rebuild for a Wauwatosa, WI battery materials startup.
- [W.A.R. (We All Related)](https://www.nodedev.one/work/we-all-related): Static brand site for a Detroit apparel movement, no checkout by design.
- [Zanapronto](https://www.nodedev.one/work/zanapronto): A Nouvos product. Multi-tenant platform for doctors with booking, a patient portal, messaging, and mobile apps.

## Pricing
Flat monthly subscriptions, billed in USD. Each plan includes a monthly credit
allowance spent against a published service catalog, plus a one-time setup fee.
Member, Growth, and Pro run on a 12-month commitment, billed monthly. Each also has a Flexible
rate: a 3-month minimum, then month to month, priced 25% above the 12-month rate.

- Member: $300/month, $312 setup. Includes hosting and small edits for your website. 140 credits/month, 2 active requests, 5-business-day target turnaround.
- Growth: $500/month, $1,092 setup. 350 credits/month, 5 active requests, 3-business-day target turnaround.
- Pro: $900/month, $1,560 setup. 650 credits/month, unlimited active requests, 2-business-day target turnaround.
- Flexible rate: Member $375/month, Growth $625/month, Pro $1,125/month, same setup fees and credits.
- On demand: $5 for one month of platform access, no renewal; credits bought as needed at $2.75 each.

SEO, GEO, and AEO are add-ons to any plan, not included in Member, Growth, or Pro:
- Starter SEO: $1,250/month.
- Full SEO: $2,500/month.
- Full SEO, GEO, and AEO: $4,000/month.

Dedicated retainer engagements are quoted separately at https://www.nodedev.one/dedicated.
Dedicated Jump includes Starter SEO. Dedicated Pro includes full SEO, GEO, and AEO.

## What makes N.O.D.E. different
- Work is delivered by an in-house team, not routed to a freelancer marketplace.
- Target turnaround is set by plan: 5 business days on Member, 3 on Growth, and 2 on Pro.
  All turnaround is subject to scope of work; larger builds are scheduled by scope.
- It is operated by Nouvos Solutions LLC, which runs its own production supply chain
  software (transportation, order, and warehouse management), so the team builds and
  operates real multi-tenant systems rather than only client sites.
- Bilingual delivery in English and Spanish.
- Two revision rounds are included per request; each extra round costs 10% of the request's credits.
- Clients own what is built for them: work is paid upfront, and the code, design, and
  content belong to the client.

Headquartered in Evanston, Illinois. In-person meetings are available by appointment in
Illinois and Wisconsin; Indiana and Texas are served remotely. Serving businesses in:
- [Chicago, IL](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/chicago-il): plus Skokie, Oak Park, Park Ridge, Des Plaines, Arlington Heights, Schaumburg, Elmhurst, Oak Brook, Downers Grove, Naperville, Aurora, Joliet, Orland Park.

- [Kenosha, WI](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/kenosha-wi): plus Pleasant Prairie, Somers, Bristol, Salem Lakes, Twin Lakes, Paddock Lake, Racine, Mount Pleasant, Sturtevant.

- [Northwest Indiana](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/northwest-indiana): Hammond, Gary, Munster, Highland, Schererville, Merrillville, Crown Point, Hobart, Portage, Valparaiso, Chesterton, Michigan City.
- [Indianapolis, IN](https://www.nodedev.one/locations/indianapolis-in): plus Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Westfield, Zionsville, Lawrence, Greenwood, Plainfield, Avon, Brownsburg.

App and custom software projects are scoped and quoted per project after a discovery
call. Web, design, and marketing work runs on the subscription plans above; SEO, GEO, and AEO are add-ons.
